title: Per-Route errorComponent
prompt:
Catch loader errors locally with `errorComponent` so the rest of the app keeps working. **Requirements:** 1. In `router.tsx`, import the usual TanStack Router primitives. 2. Define: - `rootRoute = createRootRoute({ component: () => })` - `flakyRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => rootRoute, path: '/flaky', loader: () => { throw new Error('boom'); }, errorComponent: ({ error }) =>

err: {(error as Error).message}

, component: () =>

flaky-ok

})` 3. Export `App` + `makeRouter`. Default `initialEntries` to `['/flaky']`.
hints: When the loader throws, `errorComponent` renders instead of `component` -- with the error passed as a prop.
A root-level `errorComponent` is your last resort -- per-route is more granular.
TanStack Router's `ErrorComponent` helper formats errors nicely in dev; in tests, render whatever your design system needs.
